title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant

Location: Gloucester (occasional travel to other offices required)
Position: Full Time - Permanent

If you're an ambitious Accounts Assistant looking to expand your skills and build a long-term career within a supportive and growing accountancy firm, this could be the perfect opportunity.

Our client is looking to welcome a motivated individual into their friendly and collaborative team. Whether you're studying, fully qualified, or qualified through experience, they're far more interested in your attitude, commitment, and desire to develop than your qualification status alone.

This is a varied role that offers excellent exposure, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working with a diverse client portfolio and wants to broaden their technical expertise.

What you'll be doing
- Managing bookkeeping for a wide range of clients across different industries
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns accurately and on time
- Assisting with the production of year-end accounts
- Supporting the preparation of personal and corporate tax returns
- Building strong relationships with clients, responding to queries and gathering information
- Working closely with colleagues to help manage workflow and support the wider team

What we're looking for
- Previous experience working within an accountancy practice
- Experience with bookkeeping, VAT, and accounts preparation
- Exposure to tax work would be advantageous but is not essential
- Familiarity with Sage would be beneficial, although training can be provided
- A proactive and dependable approach with a genuine eagerness to learn
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage your own workload effectively
- Someone seeking a stable, long-term opportunity where they can grow and develop

If you're looking for a role where you can continue to learn, take on greater responsibility, and become an integral part of a growing practice, we'd love to hear from you.

Next steps

If this sounds like a great opportunity and you can demonstrate the skills and enthusiasm required, then please click Apply to upload your CV for consideration. Alternatively, contact Ceris Mansfield on or

We also welcome confidential conversations about your career if this role is not quite the right fit.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Credit Controller 6 Month FTC
description:
As an Interim Credit Controller on a 6-month fixed-term contract, you'll be responsible for managing customer accounts and ensuring timely payment collections. Based in Gloucester, your role will play a key part in maintaining smooth cash flow for the business services sector.

Client Details

This role is with a company operating within the business services industry, based in Gloucester.

Description
- Monitor and manage customer accounts to ensure payments are up to date.
- Chase overdue payments via phone, email, and written communication.
- Reconcile accounts and resolve any payment discrepancies.
- Maintain accurate records of all credit control activities.
- Prepare reports on outstanding debts and payment trends.
- Liaise with internal departments to resolve customer queries.
- Assist with setting and reviewing credit limits for customers.
- Support the wider finance team with ad hoc duties as required.

Profile

A successful Interim Credit Controller should have:
- Proven experience in credit control or a similar accounting role.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Good attention to detail and accuracy in record-keeping.
- Confidence in working with financial systems and Excel.
- The ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise effectively.
- A proactive approach to resolving payment issues.

Job Offer
- Salary between £27,000 and £33,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- 6-month fixed-term contract.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Finance Officer/Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company

Hays Accountancy & Finance are exclusively partnering with an established & prestigious educational organisation to recruit a dynamic & hands-on Finance Officer/Credit controller to join their team in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire. Reporting directly to the Billing & Collections Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of fees and income, ensuring billing is accurate, along with credit control processes to ensure overdue accounts are monitored and followed up professionally. This is an exciting and varied opportunity for a Finance Officer/Credit Controller to join the organisation through a period of process improvement and change, where you can really add value and make the role your own. Best suited to finance professionals with previous Credit Control experience, who enjoy relationship building both internally & externally.

Your new role

Your key duties will involve credit control processes, including monitoring outstanding fees, managing payment plans and escalating any issues to senior management, along with assisting with debt reporting. You will prepare and issue termly fee bills, reconcile billing accounts, maintain accurate customer records, reconcile payments, resolve accounts queries directly with the customers, along with supporting process improvement projects for the billing/income processes. You will prepare and process direct debit collections, administer direct debit processes in compliance with BACs regulations, and investigate any failed collections. You will support maintaining the fees billing system, working closely with other teams around the organisation to ensure accurate data input. This is an evolving and changing position where you can really add value working within a close-knit team, reporting directly to the Billing & Collections Manager.

What you'll need to succeed

To be considered for this permanent Finance Officer/Credit Control role, you will need some experience in a similar position, a team player who is comfortable working within a close-knit team. A strong problem solver capable of using their own initiative, experience of accurate data management for invoicing and proven experience of debtor management. The ability to work under pressure to meet deadlines with high accuracy, excellent communication skills and a telephone manner to build both internal and external relationships. Experience with financial systems, adaptable to organisational needs, and a process improvement mind-set. Experience within the education sector or school finance, billing systems, business to customer collections and knowledge of direct debit collections would be advantageous but not essential.

What you'll get in return

This permanent Finance Officer/Credit Control role offers a permanent salary up to £32,000 per annum, dependable on experience based in Cheltenham, Gloucestershire. A full-time role with benefits including a contributed pension scheme, use of organisations sport facilities, free lunches, life insurance, private health care options, a Christmas shutdown and more. A great opportunity to really add value by joining one of Cheltenham's most well-known educational organisations during a period of change and transformation.

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now. If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and employment business for the supply of temporary workers. By applying for this job you accept the T&C's, Privacy Policy and Disclaimers which can be found at hays.co.uk

title: French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator
description:
Job Title: French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator

Location: Cirencester, hybrid after probation

Contract: Permanent, full-time, Monday - Friday: 8.30am - 5pm with early finishes on Fridays

Salary: £40,000-45,000 DOE + discretionary annual bonus

Our growing international client is a leader in the medtech industry and is on the lookout for a French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator professional to join them during their exciting growth period!

In this role, you'll be supporting the accurate and timely processing of payroll, focussing on the French market, acting as a first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries from employees and managers, and supporting the company's global HR department.

Why join:
- An annual salary of £40,000-45,000 DOE + discretionary annual bonus
- Join a global, leading company during their growth period and make a direct impact on healthcare
- Excellent opportunities for growth and progression, including support with achieving your CIPP
- Free breakfast and canteen lunches with hot and cold meals
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probationary period, 3x days on-site
- Generous pension, going up to 9.7% after 18 months
- Private medical insurance with BUPA for you and your family
- Passionate, friendly, collaborative and international company culture with a shared goal
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
- And more!

As the French speaking Payroll & HR Coordinator, you'll:
- Support the accurate and timely processing of payroll, focussing on the French market
- Maintain employee and payroll data, ensuring accuracy and compliance
- Process payroll changes, including new starters, leavers, salary adjustments, benefits and absences
- Act as a first point of contact for payroll and benefits queries from employees and managers
- Administer employee benefits and support monthly payroll reporting
- Assist with payroll audits, reconciliations, and HR administration tasks
- Collaborate with HR, Finance and external payroll providers to ensure smooth operations

Who we're looking for:
- Native-level French speaker with fluent English
- 2+ years of experience in French payroll processes and legislation
- High level of attention to detail
- Excellent communication skills
- Solution-based approach

If this sounds like you, please apply either directly or reach out to Aylin at for a confidential chat to find out more.

Candidates must hold full right to work status for the UK, without requiring sponsorship for the foreseeable future.

Please be advised CVs will be treated in the strictest of confidence and that your application will not be forwarded without your permission.

We aim to respond promptly; however, due to the high level of applications, we are only able to contact candidates to applicants whose experience closely matches our client's requirements.

For more opportunities, please visit our website.

title: HR & Payroll Administrator
description:
HR & Payroll Administrator Full-time Permanent 39 Hours per Week £28,500 - £30,000 per annum

Are you an experienced HR and Payroll Administrator looking for a varied role within a professional and supportive business environment?Pertemps are recruiting for an HR & Payroll Administrator to provide accurate and efficient payroll and HR administrative support. Reporting to the HR Manager, you will play a key role in maintaining employee records, processing payroll information, and supporting HR administration throughout the employee lifecycle.

The Role
Working as an HR & Payroll Administrator, you will provide accurate and timely payroll and HR administrative support, ensuring employee data, payroll information and HR documentation are maintained in line with company procedures and statutory requirements.This role is focused on administration and processing activities and does not involve providing HR policy, employee relations or people management advice.

Key Responsibilities
- Process monthly payroll inputs, including starters, leavers, pay changes, overtime, absences and expenses
- Liaise with the payroll bureau to resolve payroll queries and meet payroll deadlines
- Administer SSP, SMP, SPP, SAP, P45s, P60s and pension auto-enrolment processes
- Maintain accurate employee records and HR system data
- Manage new starter and leaver administration, including right-to-work checks, references and contracts
- Produce standard employment documentation and routine HR/payroll reports
- Maintain absence, holiday, training and certification records
- Ensure all employee information is handled in line with GDPR and company policies

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience within a payroll and/or HR administration role
- Good understanding of payroll processes and statutory payroll requirements
- Experience using HR/payroll systems such as Sage, iTrent, BrightHR or similar
- Strong Excel skills and excellent attention to detail
- Knowledge of right-to-work checks and HR administration procedures
- GCSEs (or equivalent) including Maths and English at Grade C/4 or above
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage deadlines effectively

What's on Offer
- Permanent, full-time opportunity
- Salary of £28,500 - £30,000 per annum
- Professional and supportive working environment
- Varied role combining both HR and payroll responsibilities
- Opportunity to develop and grow within an established business

Interested?

title: Part Time Accounts Administrator
description:
Unique permanent opportunity to become a valued, long-term member of a growing and successful growing business!

The role will be an integral administrative support to small and friendly management team within a very well-established local family run manufacturing business based in Hempsted, Gloucester.

This job will suit someone who wants to become a key member of the business, not just process paperwork. The successful candidate will take ownership of the finance function, support the directors with financial information and help ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the business. They are looking for someone that they can trust to manage this vital area.

Responsibilities:
- Manage the company's accounts using Sage 50 Accounts.
- Administer the Construction Industry Scheme (CIS), including subcontractor verification and monthly returns.
- Prepare applications for payment and raise sales invoices.
- Complete monthly bank reconciliations.
- Process supplier invoices, prepare supplier payments and issue remittance advices.
- Manage credit control and monitor customer payments.
- Monitor cash flow and provide financial updates to management.
- Assist with VAT preparation and complete quarterly VAT returns.
- Maintain accurate financial records and assist with month-end procedures.
- Carry out general office administration and provide day-to-day support to the management team.
- Identify opportunities to improve financial processes and office efficiency.
- Assist with any other administrative duties required within a busy family-run business.

Candidate Attributes:
- Previous relevant accounts experience.
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office (particularly Excel).
- Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to work independently and confidently manage multiple priorities.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- High level of integrity, discretion and confidentiality.

Hours - Monday - Friday - 26 - 30 hours - flexible

Salary - Highly competitive and negotiable depending on experience

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Robert Half are working in partnership with a rapidly growing, forward-thinking business near Cirencester to recruit a Payroll Administrator to join their payroll function on a full-time permanent basis. This is an excellent opportunity that will work closely with the Payroll Supervisor to assist with processing payroll data and calculations, pension processing and preparing the payroll on a weekly and monthly basis. This is a brilliant opportunity for an experienced individual that is looking for a new challenge and be a part of a business that is experiencing year on year growth. This is a full-time permanent position that will be office based, offering a salary between £27,000 - £30,000 plus hybrid working and excellent benefits.

The Role

The main duties of the Payroll Administrator will consist of the following:
- Processing the weekly and monthly payroll.
- Processing and reconciling pension contributions.
- Processing starters and leavers.
- Processing P45's and P60's.
- Liaising with employees and pension providers, dealing with queries.
- Calculating sick pay.
- Working closely with the Payroll Supervisor and support with adhoc tasks and requests.

Requirements

To be considered for the Payroll Administrator role, you must ideally possess the following skills/attributes:
- Must have experience in payroll processing
- Highly organised
- Strong work ethic
- Good team player
- Excellent attention to detail
- Good communication skills
- Competent user of Excel

Salary & Benefits
- £27,000 - £30,000 annual salary
- Hybrid working; 2 days from home, 3 days in the office
- 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
- Pension scheme
- Private health care
- On-site parking
- Excellent office facilities
- Annual staff events

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion.
